Demand Gen: Flood Relief & Cow Seva Donations

Dashboard data · 18–27 Sep 2026
Campaign setup and objective

Ran the New Flood Donation Demand Gen campaign at ₹12,000/day with Maximize Conversions bidding and view-through conversion tracking. Targeted India in English and Hindi to drive donation conversions.

Placements and formats

Combined YouTube Shorts with Google video partner placements, using video appeals and multiple headlines with a clear donate call-to-action.

Result

3.63x ROAS on 9,81,730 impressions: about 352 online conversions at ₹344.22 each.

Donation Funnel: Guardian of Angels Trust

Dashboard data · 29 Aug–27 Sep 2026
Campaign scope

Managed several donation ad sets over 30 days: Monkey Rescue, Gaumata Seva, Dog Surgery appeals and Purnima/Ekadashi drives.

Image vs. video test

In the Monkey-ads-set-11082026 - 6 ad set, the image ad had the lower cost per result (₹186.09, 11 donations). The video ad brought the volume: ₹12,903.72 spent, 1,41,310 impressions, 34 donations at ₹379.52.

Ad set efficiency

The main ad set produced 45 donation conversions from 1,45,416 impressions and 1,21,738 people reached, at a healthy frequency of 1.19.
